name: Oleafly
title: Oleafly: free Overleaf alternative
hook: Overleaf charges you twenty five dollars a month for full history and Zotero citations. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It compiles your paper right on your computer.
features.say: LaTeX, Typst and Markdown, with the PDF right beside your text.
Cite from your Zotero library as you type.
Start from over seventeen hundred templates, with full history and GitHub sync.

caption:
Overleaf Standard charges $25/month for full history and Zotero citations. Oleafly does it for free 📄

✅ Compiles LaTeX, Typst and Markdown on your own computer
✅ Cite from your Zotero library as you type
✅ 1,700+ templates, full version history and GitHub sync
✅ No subscription, no account, no tracking, 100% free

💻 Mac (Apple Silicon) · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Heads up: Oleafly is still in beta, and live co-writing needs a shared Oleafly Server your lab sets up

Comment "PAPER" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
